[[File:Kabam.jpg|thumb|220x220px]]
"'''Kabam''' is an entertainment company that is one of the world’s leaders of AAA console quality games for mobile devices."  They have made mobile games based on some of entertainment’s most iconic franchises, including ''Marvel'', ''Fast & Furious'', and ''Transformers''.

Kabam changed their logo to a K in 2019.
